query_text: A parcel is being brought under the title-registration system. According to the Registration of Title Act, what official map must the registration of title follow?

pool.heading: Registration of title to land parcel to be in accordance with Cadastral Map.
pool.text: The registration of title to every land parcel under this Act shall be in accordance with the cadastral map prepared for that purpose.

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "instrument"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a document having the effect of conveying title to and interest in any land parcel in the prescribed form,

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "interest in land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an interest Jess than full ownership of the land parcel and includes any Servitudes or encumbrance over such land parcel;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes land covered with water, and any benefit arising out of any land, all things attached to the earth or permanently fastened thereto ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "licensed auctioneer"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an auctioneer licensed under the Auctioneers and Brokers Ordinance (Chapter 109);

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means-

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to a land parcel the person named in the Title Register as the owner thereof, and ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to an interest in a land parcel, the person named in the register as the person in whose favour the interest is registered;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an area of land separately delineated on the cadastral map ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Registrar-General of Title"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes any Deputy or Assistant;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Registrar of Title"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person appointed as Registrar of Title under this Act;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "registered land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a land parcel the title to which is registered under this Act;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "servitude"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a right enjoyed by a person over a land parcel owned by another person ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Surveyor-General"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the officer appointed as Surveyor-General of Sri Lanka or any other officer appointed in writing to act on his behalf for the purposes of this Act to the extent specified in such letter of appointment;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Superintendent of Surveys"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person performing the functions of a Superintendent of Surveys in the Survey Department;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Title Register"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the Title Register under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Inspection of Register and cadastral map.
pool.text: Any person may, on application made in the prescribed form and on payment of the prescribed fee inspect during office hours, any title register and any cadastral map maintained under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Inspection of Register and cadastral map.
pool.text: Any, person shall, on application made to the relevant Registrar of Title and on payment of the prescribed fee, be entitled to receive an extract of such Title Register certified by such Registrar of Title.

pool.heading: Inspection of Register and cadastral map.
pool.text: Any person on application made to the relevant Superintendent of Surveys, shall on payment of the prescribed fee be entitled to receive a copy of an extract of a cadastral map used for registration of title, certified on behalf of the Surveyor-General.

pool.heading: Unit of record.
pool.text: The unit of record in a Title Register maintained under section 3 shall be a land parcel shown on the cadastral map.

pool.heading: Prior Title.
pool.text: Title to a land parcel or any interest pertaining to a land parcel appearing in the Register shall have priority according to the order in which the instruments pertaining to such title or interest were presented for registration irrespective of the dates of the instruments and the date of the entry in the Register.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Any owner or owners of any land parcel or land parcels whose title to which has been registered under this Act, may amalgamate or sub-divide his or their land parcel by registering a plan of redivision or amalgamation or sub-division relating to such land parcels in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: An application for amalgamation or sub-division shall be made to the Registrar of Title with copy to the relevant Superintendant of Surveys and shall contain a declaration in the prescribed form made by the applicant which shall contain-

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the particulars of every encumbrance, lis pendens, seizure, order or decree affecting the land parcel or land parcels if any;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a reference to the Title Register and a reference to the cadastral map registered in respect of such land parcel or land parcels;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a survey plan prepared by a duly authorized Surveyor in accordance with any regulation governing the conduct of such surveys and the preparation of such cadastral map showing the amalgamation or sub division of such land parcel or land parcels bearing a reference to the cadastral map showing such area;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Where the Superintendent of Surveys is satisfied that' the plan conforms to the cadastral map and any regulation governing such surveys and cadastral map, he shall notify the person who tendered such plan accordingly, and shall certify such plan on behalf of the Surveyor-General and shall cause necessary amendments to be made showing such sub-division or amalgamation on the cadastral map and forward a copy of the section of the cadastral map reflecting such amendment to the Registrar of Title of the District in which such Sand is situate.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The original of the plan tendered, field notes and request of the owners shall be filed of record in the Office of the Superintendant of Surveys.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: (a) On receipt of a certified section of a cadastral Map from the Superintendent of Surveys the Registrar of Title shall, if he is satisfied that such application for subdivision or amalgamation conforms to the provisions of this Act and the regulations made thereunder, register such land parcel or land parcels in the Title Register with accurate cross-references to the former Title records relating to such land.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The application and documents received shall be filed by the Registrar of Title in the relevant parcels file.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Upon the registration of a plan of amalgamation, or sub-division-

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the land parcel or land parcels depicted therein shall be deemed to be amalgamated or sub-divided as defined therein;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: such land parcel or land parcels shall be subject to the burden and shall have the benefit, of any servitudes affecting such land parcel or land parcels in the original cadastral map relating to such land parcel or land parcels as are included in the plan of amalgamation or sub-division.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: On registration of a title of co-ownership under paragraph (d) of section 14, the Commissioner of Title Settlement may appoint one among the co-owners as Manager of such co-owned land parcel with the consent of the majority of such co-owners.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: Such Manager shall have the authority, powers and obligations of a trustee under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87).

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: The duties of the Manager shall include the following:-

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: to maintain the said land parcel in a state conducive for optimum production,

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: to disburse the profits accrued from such land parcel among the beneficiaries according to their shares of co-ownership after setting off any expenses and the fees due to him for such management.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: The power of the Manager shall include the power to mortgage such land parcel with the consent of the co-owners to raise funds for the development of the land parcel.

pool.heading: Additional surveys.
pool.text: Where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the opinion that any additional surveys are necessary for the cadastral map to reflect his subsequent findings, he shall request the Surveyor-General to conduct such additional surveys and effect the necessary definition of boundaries.

pool.heading: Additional surveys.
pool.text: The Surveyor-General shall effect the necessary definition of boundaries and conduct such surveys as are required by the Commissioner of Title Settlement and forward a revised cadastral map to the Commissioner of Title Settlement.

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: On the Superintendent of Surveys being satisfied that the condominium plan conforms to the provisions of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973 and this Act, he shall certify such plan on behalf of the Surveyor-General, and -

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: file the original of the condominium plan after making a suitable reference on the cadastral map used for registration of title; and

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: forward the duplicate of the condominium plan and the application of the owner to the appropriate Registrar of Title.

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act and of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973, the owner of any land parcel registered under this Act upon which a building comprising more than one storey has been constructed, may, upon payment of the prescribed fee make application in the prescribed form to the Registrar-General of Title for the registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings (hereinafter referred to as "condominium parcels") in accordance with a cadastral map called a condominium plan which shall accompany such application.

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: The reference number of the land parcel on which the building is constructed and the number of the condominium parcel as depicted on the cadastral map shall together be a sufficient reference to a condominium parcel.

pool.heading: Registration of horizontal sub-division of buildings.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall refer such applications together with the condominium plan and the cadastral map to the Superintendent of Surveys for certification.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: (a) Any instrument attested in terms of section 44 together with the Certificate of Title pertaining to the title of the vendor shall be forwarded by the Attestor working days of such attestation to the Registrar of Title within whose area of jurisdiction the land parcel dealt with in such instrument is situate.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Failure to forward the attested instrument within the stipulated period shall be an offence punishable with the prescribed penalty.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall record the receipt of such instrument in the books maintained by him under the provisions of this Act and satisfy himself of the following:-

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the instrument has been drawn in accordance with the provisions of this Act;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the land parcel has been identified and described accurately and conforms with the description of such land parcel in the Registers in the Title Registry;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the person conveying such title or interest had the capacity to execute such instrument according to the information available in the Registers in the Title Registry;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the title or interest conveyed or dealt with, has been unambiguously identified and conforms to that recorded in the Registers in the Title Registry.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: If the Registrar of Title is of the opinion that all requirements for registration under this Act are complied with, he shall register such title or interest in the prescribed manner, file the instrument creating or transferring such title or interest and the Certificate of Title submitted by the vendor in the relevant parcels file and issue a Certificate of Title to the person who tendered the instrument;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 45(3), proviso
pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Provided that where such instrument pertains to a lease or a mortgage, the old Certificate of Title too shall be returned to such person with an endorsement made on it by the Registrar of Title making reference to such lease or mortgage. The Registrar of Title shall inform the Surveyor-General of all new entries immediately upon completion of the registration.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every document purporting to be certified by a Registrar of Title shall in all proceedings be presumed to have been so certified and shall be accepted as prima facie evidence of the matter to which it relates without any further proof of such matter.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every copy of an extract of cadastral map purporting to be certified by or on behalf of the Surveyor-General, shall in all proceedings, be presumed to have been so certified and shall be accepted as prima facie evidence of the matter to which it relates.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every entry or note in or on any register, and cadastral map used for registration of title shall, subject to the provisions of this Act, be received in all proceedings as conclusive evidence of the matter or transaction which it records.

query_text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement has received certified copies of cadastral maps for an area. Explain how potential claimants are invited to submit claims and what must happen after claims are received.

pool.heading: Publication of Notice.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall, on receipt of such certified copies of cadastral maps publish a Notice in the Gazette, calling for any claimants to the land parcel specified in such Notice to submit their claims to him within a prescribed period from the date of publication of such Notice.

pool.heading: Preparation of cadastral maps.
pool.text: On the publication of an Order under section 1 of this Act, the Commissioner of Title Settlement shall request the Surveyor-General to prepare cadastral maps for the areas specified in such Order and upon such request the Surveyor-General shall cause such cadastral maps to be prepared and certified copies of the same to be issued to the Commissioner of Title Settlement.

pool.heading: Reference of claims to District Court.
pool.text: If, during the course of investigations, the Commissioner of Title Settlement forms the opinion that, due to the disputed nature of the claims, it would be more, appropriate for the investigations to be carried out by the District Court, the Commissioner of Title Settlement may refer such claims for investigation and determination to the District Court having jurisdiction over the area where the land is situate.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every document purporting to be certified by a Registrar of Title shall in all proceedings be presumed to have been so certified and shall be accepted as prima facie evidence of the matter to which it relates without any further proof of such matter.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every copy of an extract of cadastral map purporting to be certified by or on behalf of the Surveyor-General, shall in all proceedings, be presumed to have been so certified and shall be accepted as prima facie evidence of the matter to which it relates.

pool.heading: Certification by Registrar to be prima facie evidence.
pool.text: Every entry or note in or on any register, and cadastral map used for registration of title shall, subject to the provisions of this Act, be received in all proceedings as conclusive evidence of the matter or transaction which it records.

pool.heading: Additional surveys.
pool.text: Where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the opinion that any additional surveys are necessary for the cadastral map to reflect his subsequent findings, he shall request the Surveyor-General to conduct such additional surveys and effect the necessary definition of boundaries.

pool.heading: Additional surveys.
pool.text: The Surveyor-General shall effect the necessary definition of boundaries and conduct such surveys as are required by the Commissioner of Title Settlement and forward a revised cadastral map to the Commissioner of Title Settlement.

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: On the conclusion of the investigation in terms of section 13. the Commissioner of Title Settlement shall publish in the Gazette, his determination thereon as follows:-

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant to a land parcel has a title of Absolute Ownership, he shall declare such claimant eligible to be registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant does not qualify for a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership but the claimant is in bonafide possession of the land parcel, he may declare the claimant eligible to be registered with a Second Class Title of Ownership with the right, at the end of a period of uninterrupted and unchallenged possession of ten years from the date of registration in such capacity, to have such Second Class Title converted to a registration with First Class Title of Absolute Ownership;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that the claimant has established a claim to a part of the land parcel claimed he shall declare the claimant eligible to be registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership or a Second Class Title of Ownership, as the case may be, to a divided portion of such parcel;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that it is not possible to recognise one or more of such claims without reducing the extent of a divided portion of a land parcel below the prescribed economic unit, he shall declare all such claimants who have a valid claim to such parcel, eligible for registration as co-owners of such parcel with a title of co-ownership to the extent of the individual claimant's co-ownership.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: If a registered owner dies intestate, any party interested may inform the Commissioner of Title Settlement of the death of such registered owner.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall on being so notified, publish a notice in the prescribed manner calling for claimants to the land parcel registered in favour of such deceased person.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 13, 14, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 27 shall apply on the Commissioner of Title Settlement calling for claimants in instances of intestate succession.

pool.heading: Reference to Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement may refer any dispute pertaining to any land parcel for settlement by the Conciliation Board appointed for the area in which such land is situate.

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: The Surveyor-General shall be responsible for Preparation of cadastral plans and maps the preparation and maintenance of all cadastral maps to cover the entirely of Sri Lanka progressively for the purposes of the Registration of Title Act, and for the purposes of any other written law.

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: A cadastral survey for the purpose of the Registration of Title Act shall be conducted by a registered surveyor (a) who is employed in the Department or

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: who possesses an Annual Practicing Licenced issued in terms of section 41,

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: and who has obtained a Certificate of Accredition in terms of section 11 The registered surveyors shall certify all maps and plans prepared by him based on a cadastral survey conducted for the purpose of this section

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: All cadastral maps and plans prepared under subsection (2) shall, be examined by the Surveyor-General or by a registered surveyor duly authorised in that behalf by the Surveyor-General and where be is satisfied that such maps and plans are in order be approved by the Surveyor-General or by such registered surveyor, as the case may be

pool.heading: Preparation of Cadastral plans and maps.
pool.text: The provisions of the State Landmarks Ordinance shall mutatis mutandis apply in respect at boundaries surveyed for the preparation of cadastral maps under the Registration of Title Act.

pool.heading: Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: There may be appointed by the Commissioner of Title Settlement, a Conciliation Board for each Grama Niladhari Division in any area specified in an Order under section 1 of this Act.

pool.heading: Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: Each such Conciliation Board shall consist of-

pool.heading: Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: not less than three and not more than seven members selected from amongst the land holders resident within such Grama Niladhari Division; and

pool.heading: Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: the Grama Niladhari of each such Division.

pool.heading: Conciliation Boards.
pool.text: Each, such Board shall elect a Chairman and a Secretary from among themselves.

pool.heading: Investigation.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall cause an investigation to be conducted in order to determine the genuinness or otherwise of claims made in response to a Notice under section 12.

pool.heading: Claimant aggrieved may make an appeal to District Court.
pool.text: Any claimant aggrieved by any Declaration of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under section 14 may prefer an appeal against such declaration within the prescribed period to the District Court having jurisdiction over the area where the land parcel is situate.

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall appoint a new Manager from among such co-owners to manage the said land parcel with the consent of the majority of the co- Owners.

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on being satisfied that the Manager is guilty of mismanagement or mala fides;

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on being satisfied that the land parcel is not being put to optimum use;

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on the death of the Manager; or

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of opinion that it is in the best interests of the co-owners to do so.

query_text: Nimal executes an instrument purporting to transfer an interest in a land parcel registered under the Registration of Title Act. Determine whether the transferee acquired the interest and explain when an instrument relating to registered land takes legal effect.

pool.heading: Interest in land parcel not acquired unless registration.
pool.text: No person acquiring an interest in any land parcel registered under the provisions of this Act shall be entitled to such title or interest unless such title or interest is registered under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "instrument"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a document having the effect of conveying title to and interest in any land parcel in the prescribed form,

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "interest in land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an interest Jess than full ownership of the land parcel and includes any Servitudes or encumbrance over such land parcel;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes land covered with water, and any benefit arising out of any land, all things attached to the earth or permanently fastened thereto ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "licensed auctioneer"

pool.text: means an auctioneer licensed under the Auctioneers and Brokers Ordinance (Chapter 109);

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means-

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to a land parcel the person named in the Title Register as the owner thereof, and ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "owner"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: in relation to an interest in a land parcel, the person named in the register as the person in whose favour the interest is registered;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Land parcel"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means an area of land separately delineated on the cadastral map ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Registrar-General of Title"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: includes any Deputy or Assistant;

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person appointed as Registrar of Title under this Act;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "registered land"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a land parcel the title to which is registered under this Act;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "servitude"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a right enjoyed by a person over a land parcel owned by another person ;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Surveyor-General"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means the officer appointed as Surveyor-General of Sri Lanka or any other officer appointed in writing to act on his behalf for the purposes of this Act to the extent specified in such letter of appointment;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Superintendent of Surveys"
pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person performing the functions of a Superintendent of Surveys in the Survey Department;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "Title Register"
pool.heading: Interpretation.

pool.heading: Instrument to take effect on registration.
pool.text: An instrument pertaining to land executed in accordance with the provisions of this Act shall take effect on registration, of such instrument under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Who may present instrument for registration.
pool.text: An instrument for conveying interest in a land parcel may be presented for title registration under this Act to the Registrar of Title by-

pool.heading: Who may present instrument for registration.
pool.text: any person claiming any interest or benefit thereunder;

pool.heading: Who may present instrument for registration.
pool.text: any person having any interest in or charge on any land affected thereby; or

pool.heading: Who may present instrument for registration.
pool.text: any person attesting such instrument.

pool.heading: Who may present instrument for registration.
pool.text: An instrument may be presented for registration through post or under cover if it is accompanied by the appropriate fee, if any.

pool.heading: Effect of registration.
pool.text: The registration of a person with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership to a land parcel, shall vest in that person absolute ownership of such land parcel together with all rights and privileges belonging or appurtenant thereto, subject to any subsisting interests as registered in the Encumbrances Section of the Title Register.

pool.heading: Effect of registration.
pool.text: The registration of a person under the provisions of this Act as a person having ownership or an interest in a land parcel or a charge or encumbrance on or over such land parcel, or as a Manager or beneficiary shall vest in that person the rights so registered together with all rights and privileges belonging or appurtenant there to, whether express or implied and subject to any express agreements relating thereto.

pool.heading: Registration of Ownership.
pool.text: Where any person has become the owner or has acquired an interest in any land parcel registered under this Act by virtue of any order or certificate of sale made or issued under any law, the Registrar of Title shall, on the application of such person supported by such evidence as he may require, register such person as the owner of such land parcel or of any interest therein.

pool.heading: Registration of Ownership.
pool.text: Where any person becomes entitled to function in the capacity of an owner by virtue of any court order the Registrar of Title shall, upon application made in that behalf with supporting documentation which shall be to his satisfaction, register such person in such capacity.

pool.heading: Duties of Attestor.
pool.text: A Notary Public attesting an instrument in terms of this Act shall-

pool.heading: Duties of Attestor.
pool.text: satisfy himself regarding the identity of whosoever of the parties to the transaction and the witnesses, as are not known to him, by reference to their official identity cards or such other means as may reliably reveal their identity;

pool.heading: Duties of Attestor.
pool.text: satisfy himself about the capacity of the persons who are parties to the instrument by reference to the records in the Title Registry or by reference to an extract from the relevant Title Register;

pool.heading: Duties of Attestor.
pool.text: satisfy himself about the identity of the land and the state of the title dealt with in such instrument by reference to the Certificate of Title issued by the Registrar of Title and to the records in the Title Registry.

pool.heading: Transactions relating to a land parcel to be made in accordance with Act.
pool.text: No land parcel, title to which has been registered under this Act, or any interest therein shall be transferred or dealt with except in accordance with the provisions of this Act, and every disposition otherwise effected shall be void.

pool.heading: Retention and destruction of instruments.
pool.text: Any instrument accepted by the Registrar of Title shall be retained in the Title Registry for as long as it supports a current entry in the register and for ten years thereafter.

pool.heading: Retention and destruction of instruments.
pool.text: Where an entry in the register pertaining to title or an interest in a land parcel has been superseded or has ceased to have effect, the Registrar of Title shall make a note to that effect in the Register against such entry.

pool.heading: Retention and destruction of instruments.
pool.text: On the expiry of ten years after an entry in the register pertaining to title or an interest in a Sand parcel has been, superseded or has ceased to have effect, the Registrar of Title shall destroy in the prescribed manner any instrument which supported the entry and make an entry to that effect in the Register.

pool.heading: The Registrar of Title not to register instrument conveying title in future.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall not register any instrument which purports to convey any title or interest to a land parcel on the happening of any event, or the fulfilment of any condition at any future time:

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 46, proviso
pool.heading: The Registrar of Title not to register instrument conveying title in future.
pool.text: Provided however, that a conveyance of title subject to life interest shall be acceptable for registration.

pool.heading: Form of instruments relating to a land parcel.
pool.text: Every instrument conveying title or any interest in a land parcel presented for registration under this Act shall be effected in the form prescribed for that purpose.

pool.heading: Form of instruments relating to a land parcel.
pool.text: Instruments prepared under the provisions of subsection (1) shall be signed by the parties to the transaction and two witnesses and attested by a Notary Public, and in the case of State land, by a Notary Public or by any public officer authorized to do so, by or under any law.

pool.heading: Registration of wills, and instruments executed in terms there of.
pool.text: Where a registered owner dies testate, grant of probate of the will and any instrument executed in terms of the will shall be forwarded to the Registrar of Title in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Registration of wills, and instruments executed in terms there of.
pool.text: Any provision of a will that makes a person owner of an undivided share or of a divided share smaller in extent than the prescribed minimum extent of a land parcel that may be registered under this Act shall have no legal effect.

pool.heading: Registration of wills, and instruments executed in terms there of.
pool.text: A Court in which an application is filed or proved in respect of a provision of a will referred to in sub-section (2) shall order a sale of such land parcel among the contending claimants.

pool.heading: Registration of wills, and instruments executed in terms there of.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 29 and 30 shall be applicable to Court proceedings in case of testate succession.

pool.heading: Where Court orders rectification.
pool.text: Subject to section 60, a Court may order rectification of the Register where it is satisfied that any registration has been obtained by fraud:

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 59, proviso
pool.heading: Where Court orders rectification.
pool.text: Provided however, that a Court shall not order the rectification of a register so as to affect the title of a registered owner who is in possession and who has acquired the land parcel or interest therein for valuable consideration, unless such owner was a party to such fraud.

pool.heading: Part of land parcel not to be transferred unless new registers are opened.
pool.text: No part of a land parcel registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership or a Second Class Title of Ownership under the provisions of this Act shall be transferred or otherwise dealt with unless the registered owner has first sub-divided such land parcel and the land parcel so subdivided has been registered under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: (a) Any instrument attested in terms of section 44 together with the Certificate of Title pertaining to the title of the vendor shall be forwarded by the Attestor working days of such attestation to the Registrar of Title within whose area of jurisdiction the land parcel dealt with in such instrument is situate.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Failure to forward the attested instrument within the stipulated period shall be an offence punishable with the prescribed penalty.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall record the receipt of such instrument in the books maintained by him under the provisions of this Act and satisfy himself of the following:-

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the instrument has been drawn in accordance with the provisions of this Act;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the land parcel has been identified and described accurately and conforms with the description of such land parcel in the Registers in the Title Registry;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the person conveying such title or interest had the capacity to execute such instrument according to the information available in the Registers in the Title Registry;

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: that the title or interest conveyed or dealt with, has been unambiguously identified and conforms to that recorded in the Registers in the Title Registry.

pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: If the Registrar of Title is of the opinion that all requirements for registration under this Act are complied with, he shall register such title or interest in the prescribed manner, file the instrument creating or transferring such title or interest and the Certificate of Title submitted by the vendor in the relevant parcels file and issue a Certificate of Title to the person who tendered the instrument;

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 45(3), proviso
pool.heading: Attestor to forward instruments attested within seven days.
pool.text: Provided that where such instrument pertains to a lease or a mortgage, the old Certificate of Title too shall be returned to such person with an endorsement made on it by the Registrar of Title making reference to such lease or mortgage. The Registrar of Title shall inform the Surveyor-General of all new entries immediately upon completion of the registration.

pool.heading: Registration of interest in land parcel.
pool.text: Where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant has established his claim to the ownership or to an interest in the land parcel which is to be registered under the provisions of this Act, he shall declare such claimant eligible for registration as the owner of that land parcel or of such interest and shall register such interest in the Title Register for the duration of the subsistence of that interest.:

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 20, proviso
pool.heading: Registration of interest in land parcel.
pool.text: Provided that, where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a person declared eligible for registration as an owner under this Act, is subject to or governed by any special or personal law, he shall declare such person subject to such special or personal law, and cause a note of such fact to be made, in the Title Register.

pool.text: Except in accordance with the provisions of this Act, an instrument pertaining to the ownership of a land parcel registered under this Act, made in favour of two or more persons in common shall be void and shall not be registered under this Act.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: On registration of a title of co-ownership under paragraph (d) of section 14, the Commissioner of Title Settlement may appoint one among the co-owners as Manager of such co-owned land parcel with the consent of the majority of such co-owners.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: Such Manager shall have the authority, powers and obligations of a trustee under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87).

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: The duties of the Manager shall include the following:-

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: to maintain the said land parcel in a state conducive for optimum production,

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: to disburse the profits accrued from such land parcel among the beneficiaries according to their shares of co-ownership after setting off any expenses and the fees due to him for such management.

pool.heading: Appointment of manager powers and duties.
pool.text: The power of the Manager shall include the power to mortgage such land parcel with the consent of the co-owners to raise funds for the development of the land parcel.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Any owner or owners of any land parcel or land parcels whose title to which has been registered under this Act, may amalgamate or sub-divide his or their land parcel by registering a plan of redivision or amalgamation or sub-division relating to such land parcels in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: An application for amalgamation or sub-division shall be made to the Registrar of Title with copy to the relevant Superintendant of Surveys and shall contain a declaration in the prescribed form made by the applicant which shall contain-

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the particulars of every encumbrance, lis pendens, seizure, order or decree affecting the land parcel or land parcels if any;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a reference to the Title Register and a reference to the cadastral map registered in respect of such land parcel or land parcels;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: a survey plan prepared by a duly authorized Surveyor in accordance with any regulation governing the conduct of such surveys and the preparation of such cadastral map showing the amalgamation or sub division of such land parcel or land parcels bearing a reference to the cadastral map showing such area;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Where the Superintendent of Surveys is satisfied that' the plan conforms to the cadastral map and any regulation governing such surveys and cadastral map, he shall notify the person who tendered such plan accordingly, and shall certify such plan on behalf of the Surveyor-General and shall cause necessary amendments to be made showing such sub-division or amalgamation on the cadastral map and forward a copy of the section of the cadastral map reflecting such amendment to the Registrar of Title of the District in which such Sand is situate.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The original of the plan tendered, field notes and request of the owners shall be filed of record in the Office of the Superintendant of Surveys.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: (a) On receipt of a certified section of a cadastral Map from the Superintendent of Surveys the Registrar of Title shall, if he is satisfied that such application for subdivision or amalgamation conforms to the provisions of this Act and the regulations made thereunder, register such land parcel or land parcels in the Title Register with accurate cross-references to the former Title records relating to such land.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: The application and documents received shall be filed by the Registrar of Title in the relevant parcels file.

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: Upon the registration of a plan of amalgamation, or sub-division-

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: the land parcel or land parcels depicted therein shall be deemed to be amalgamated or sub-divided as defined therein;

pool.heading: Sub-division or amalgamation of units.
pool.text: such land parcel or land parcels shall be subject to the burden and shall have the benefit, of any servitudes affecting such land parcel or land parcels in the original cadastral map relating to such land parcel or land parcels as are included in the plan of amalgamation or sub-division.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: If a registered owner dies intestate, any party interested may inform the Commissioner of Title Settlement of the death of such registered owner.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall on being so notified, publish a notice in the prescribed manner calling for claimants to the land parcel registered in favour of such deceased person.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 13, 14, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 27 shall apply on the Commissioner of Title Settlement calling for claimants in instances of intestate succession.

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall appoint a new Manager from among such co-owners to manage the said land parcel with the consent of the majority of the co- Owners.

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on being satisfied that the Manager is guilty of mismanagement or mala fides;

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on being satisfied that the land parcel is not being put to optimum use;

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: on the death of the Manager; or

pool.heading: Power of Commissioner of Title settlement to appoint new Manager.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of opinion that it is in the best interests of the co-owners to do so.

pool.heading: Rights of co-owners.
pool.text: The co-owners shall have the rights of beneficiaries under the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87).

pool.heading: Rights of co-owners.
pool.text: The rights of the beneficiaries shall include the right to receive profits from the said land parcel.

query_text: A parcel is registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership. A person claims ownership through prescription, while another party seeks to institute a partition action concerning the same parcel. Explain whether the Prescription Ordinance and the Partition Act apply to this parcel.

pool.heading: Prescription.
pool.text: The Prescription Ordinance (Chapter 68) shall not apply to lands or interests in land registered under this Act with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership or a Second Class Title of Ownership.

pool.heading: Partition Act not to apply.
pool.text: The Partition Act shall not apply to land parcels registered under this Act with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership, or Second Class Title of Ownership

pool.heading: Conversion of Title to one of First Class Title of Absolute Ownership.
pool.text: A person registered with a Second Class Title of Ownership or a person claiming title through him shall at the end of a period of ten years from such registration, and if there has been no action under section 29 against such registration during the intervening period, be eligible for the conversion of his registration to one of First Class Title of Absolute Ownership.

pool.heading: Conversion of Title to one of First Class Title of Absolute Ownership.
pool.text: At the end of the period referred to in subsection (1), the Commissioner of Title Settlement shall prepare a Schedule of Title in terms of the provisions of this Act, certifying such person as being eligible for registration with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership and shall despatch such Schedule of Title to the appropriate Registrar of Title and to the Surveyor-General.

pool.heading: Conversion of Title to one of First Class Title of Absolute Ownership.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title shall, on receipt of a Schedule of Title under subsection (2) cause such person to be registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership to the land referred to in such Schedule of Title, and shall inform the Commissioner of Title Settlement and the Surveyor- General accordingly.

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: On the conclusion of the investigation in terms of section 13. the Commissioner of Title Settlement shall publish in the Gazette, his determination thereon as follows:-

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant to a land parcel has a title of Absolute Ownership, he shall declare such claimant eligible to be registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant does not qualify for a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership but the claimant is in bonafide possession of the land parcel, he may declare the claimant eligible to be registered with a Second Class Title of Ownership with the right, at the end of a period of uninterrupted and unchallenged possession of ten years from the date of registration in such capacity, to have such Second Class Title converted to a registration with First Class Title of Absolute Ownership;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that the claimant has established a claim to a part of the land parcel claimed he shall declare the claimant eligible to be registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership or a Second Class Title of Ownership, as the case may be, to a divided portion of such parcel;

pool.heading: Order of Declaration.
pool.text: where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that it is not possible to recognise one or more of such claims without reducing the extent of a divided portion of a land parcel below the prescribed economic unit, he shall declare all such claimants who have a valid claim to such parcel, eligible for registration as co-owners of such parcel with a title of co-ownership to the extent of the individual claimant's co-ownership.

pool.heading: Effect of registration.
pool.text: The registration of a person with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership to a land parcel, shall vest in that person absolute ownership of such land parcel together with all rights and privileges belonging or appurtenant thereto, subject to any subsisting interests as registered in the Encumbrances Section of the Title Register.

pool.heading: Effect of registration.
pool.text: The registration of a person under the provisions of this Act as a person having ownership or an interest in a land parcel or a charge or encumbrance on or over such land parcel, or as a Manager or beneficiary shall vest in that person the rights so registered together with all rights and privileges belonging or appurtenant there to, whether express or implied and subject to any express agreements relating thereto.

pool.heading: Part of land parcel not to be transferred unless new registers are opened.
pool.text: No part of a land parcel registered with a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership or a Second Class Title of Ownership under the provisions of this Act shall be transferred or otherwise dealt with unless the registered owner has first sub-divided such land parcel and the land parcel so subdivided has been registered under the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Person aggrieved by registration may apply to District Court.
pool.text: Any person aggrieved by the registration of title of a person with a Second Class Title of Ownership to any land parcel may with in a period of ten years from the date of such registration, file action for the amendment of the register, in the District Court having jurisdiction over the area in which such land parcel is situate.

pool.heading: Person aggrieved by registration may apply to District Court.
pool.text: Notice of such action shall be registered in the Encumbrances Section of the Title Register, and shall remain registered until the close of such action.

pool.heading: Person aggrieved by registration may apply to District Court.
pool.text: Notice of such action shall also be conveyed by the Registrar of Title to the person whose Second Class Title of Ownership was so registered and to the Commissioner of Title Settlement and the Surveyor-General.

pool.heading: Registration of State land.
pool.text: Where the land sought to be registered is State land, the Commissioner of Title Settlement shall prepare a Schedule of Title for the registration of a First Class Title of Absolute Ownership in the State to such land, together with details of any dispositions, reservations or liens, as the case may be.

pool.heading: Beneficiaries may request appointment of new Manager.
pool.text: The beneficiaries may apply to the Commissioner of Title Settlement to appoint another co-owner as the Manager of the co-owned land parcel, on the following grounds:-

pool.heading: Beneficiaries may request appointment of new Manager.
pool.text: mismanagement or mala fides on the part of the Manager, or

pool.heading: Beneficiaries may request appointment of new Manager.
pool.text: that the land parcel is not being put to optimum use.

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means a document having the effect of conveying title to and interest in any land parcel in the prescribed form,

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "interest in land parcel"

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "land"

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 75, definition of "licensed auctioneer"

pool.text: means an auctioneer licensed under the Auctioneers and Brokers Ordinance (Chapter 109);

pool.heading: Interpretation.
pool.text: means any person performing the functions of a Superintendent of Surveys in the Survey Department;

pool.heading: Where District Court orders amendment of Register.
pool.text: The District Court after due inquiry shall make order as the justice of the case may require.

pool.heading: Where District Court orders amendment of Register.
pool.text: (a) Where the District Court orders the amendment of the Title Register in respect of a land parcel registered with a Second Class Title of Ownership, such Order shall be conveyed to the Registrar of Title who shall cause such amendment of the register to be effected.

pool.heading: Where District Court orders amendment of Register.
pool.text: Such Order of the Court shall also be conveyed to the Commissioner of Title Settlement and the Surveyor-General.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: If a registered owner dies intestate, any party interested may inform the Commissioner of Title Settlement of the death of such registered owner.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall on being so notified, publish a notice in the prescribed manner calling for claimants to the land parcel registered in favour of such deceased person.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 13, 14, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 27 shall apply on the Commissioner of Title Settlement calling for claimants in instances of intestate succession.

pool.heading: Certificate of Title.
pool.text: Any person, having a Title of Ownership or other interest in a land parcel registered under this Act, may on payment of the prescribed fee, obtain a Certificate of Title in respect of such Ownership or interest, from the appropriate Registrar of Title.

pool.heading: Certificate of Title.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act, such Certificate of Title shall form conclusive evidence of the title to such interest.

query_text: A registration was obtained by fraud. The present registered owner is in possession, acquired the parcel for valuable consideration and was not a party to the fraud. Another person suffered loss because the register was not rectified. Explain whether the court may rectify the register against the present owner and whether the person who suffered loss may claim indemnity.

pool.heading: Where Court orders rectification.
pool.text: Subject to section 60, a Court may order rectification of the Register where it is satisfied that any registration has been obtained by fraud:

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 59, proviso
pool.heading: Where Court orders rectification.
pool.text: Provided however, that a Court shall not order the rectification of a register so as to affect the title of a registered owner who is in possession and who has acquired the land parcel or interest therein for valuable consideration, unless such owner was a party to such fraud.

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: Any person suffering loss or damage or who has been prejudiced by reason of-

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: any rectification of the Register in pursuance of an order of Court under this Act; or

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: not rectifying the Register in consequence of an order of Court made under section 59,

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: shall on an order of Court be entitled to be indemnified by the Government out of the Insurance Fund.

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: No sums shall be paid by way of indemnity under this Act, to any person who has himself caused, or substantially contributed to any fraud referred to in section 59 or who derives his title from a person who has caused or substantially contributed to such fraud.

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: Where any sum is awarded by way of indemnity on account of the loss of title to, or interest in any land it shall not exceed in any case where" (a) the register is rectified, the market value of the land parcel or the interest in such land parcel immediately before the rectification;

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: the register is not rectified, the market value of the land parcel or the interest in such land parcel at the time when the entry relating to such interest was made in the Register.

pool.heading: Person suffering loss or damage to be indemnified.
pool.text: Where any sum is awarded by way of indemnity, the Registrar-General of Title may on application to Court by way of summary procedure," recover the amount so awarded from any person who has caused or substantially contributed to the loss by his fraud or negligence.

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: The Registrar of Title may rectify the Registers and other records maintained under this Act in the following instances:-

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: On an order from the Registrar-General of Title where-

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: errors or omissions not materially affecting the interests of any proprietor, have been detected;

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: upon a resurvey as certified by the Surveyor- General, particulars contained in the register require amendment, on the Registrar-General of Title giving notice to all shown by such Register to have an interest in or likely to be affected by such amendment and calling for written representations thereon.

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: upon proof of change of name of the registered owner under the provisions of the Births and Deaths Registration Act.

pool.heading: Rectification and indemnity.
pool.text: On an order of Court to rectify such Register made under section 59.

pool.heading: Registration of Ownership.
pool.text: Where any person has become the owner or has acquired an interest in any land parcel registered under this Act by virtue of any order or certificate of sale made or issued under any law, the Registrar of Title shall, on the application of such person supported by such evidence as he may require, register such person as the owner of such land parcel or of any interest therein.

pool.heading: Registration of Ownership.
pool.text: Where any person becomes entitled to function in the capacity of an owner by virtue of any court order the Registrar of Title shall, upon application made in that behalf with supporting documentation which shall be to his satisfaction, register such person in such capacity.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: If a registered owner dies intestate, any party interested may inform the Commissioner of Title Settlement of the death of such registered owner.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The Commissioner of Title Settlement shall on being so notified, publish a notice in the prescribed manner calling for claimants to the land parcel registered in favour of such deceased person.

pool.heading: Registered owner dying intestate.
pool.text: The provisions of sections 13, 14, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 27 shall apply on the Commissioner of Title Settlement calling for claimants in instances of intestate succession.

pool.heading: No indemnity payable on surplus or deficiency.
pool.text: No claim to indemnity shall arise on account of any surplus or deficiency in the area or measurement of land certified by the Surveyor-General.

pool.heading: Registration of interest in land parcel.
pool.text: Where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a claimant has established his claim to the ownership or to an interest in the land parcel which is to be registered under the provisions of this Act, he shall declare such claimant eligible for registration as the owner of that land parcel or of such interest and shall register such interest in the Title Register for the duration of the subsistence of that interest.:

pool.citation: Registration of Title Act, s 20, proviso
pool.heading: Registration of interest in land parcel.
pool.text: Provided that, where the Commissioner of Title Settlement is of the view that a person declared eligible for registration as an owner under this Act, is subject to or governed by any special or personal law, he shall declare such person subject to such special or personal law, and cause a note of such fact to be made, in the Title Register.

query_text: A condominium plan relating to land registered under the Registration of Title Act has been approved as conforming to the applicable laws. State the principal steps that the Superintendent of Surveys and the Registrar of Title must take to file the plan and register the condominium parcels.

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: On the Superintendent of Surveys being satisfied that the condominium plan conforms to the provisions of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973 and this Act, he shall certify such plan on behalf of the Surveyor-General, and -

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: file the original of the condominium plan after making a suitable reference on the cadastral map used for registration of title; and

pool.heading: Filing of condominium plan by superintendent of surveys.
pool.text: forward the duplicate of the condominium plan and the application of the owner to the appropriate Registrar of Title.

pool.heading: Miscellaneous.
pool.text: Any State institution or local authority may make use of and have access to the registers maintained under the provisions of this Act to be used for planning, administration and other activities of such Institution or local authority.

pool.heading: Miscellaneous.
pool.text: Any State institution or local authority may request the Registrar-General of Title to include in the Registers maintained, under this Act, particulars of payments due to it on lands registered therein and the Registrar-General of Title shall accordingly take steps to record such information in the Title Register in the manner prescribed.

pool.heading: Miscellaneous.
pool.text: Any State institution or local authority may request the Registrar-General of Title to include in the Registers maintained under this Act, particulars pertaining to the natural properties of the land, any development done on the land and any servitude; on receipt of such request the Registrar -General of Title shall cause such information to be recorded in the Title Register in the prescribed manner.

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: If the Registrar of Title is satisfied that the application conforms to the provisions of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973 and this Act, he shall-

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: file the duplicate of the condominium plan in the Parcels File;

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: open a new title register in the Register in respect of each condominium parcel shown on the Condominium Plan and make suitable cross references to such register in the register in which the land parcel is registered;

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: record in the Property Section in the register pertaining to the land parcel that the land comprised therein consists only of common property;

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: record in the Encumbrances Section that registers in respect of condominium parcels have been opened;

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: inform the applicant that such condominium parcels have been registered and notify him of the reference numbers of the relevant registers; and

pool.heading: Mode of registration of condominium parcels.
pool.text: issue a Certificate of Title after recovery of the prescribed fees.

pool.text: Upon receipt of a cadastral map duly certified from the Superintendent of Surveys, the Registrar shall, if he is satisfied that such application conforms to the provisions of the of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998, and-
