query_text: A dispute arises over whether a person recorded as a shareholder has title to the shares specified in a certificate signed in the company's name by a director and the secretary. What evidential effect does that share certificate have under the Companies Act?

pool.heading: Certificate to be evidence of title.
pool.text: A certificate signed under the name of the company by a director and secretary of the company specifying any shares held by any shareholder, shall be prima facie evidence of the title of the shareholder to the shares.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the name of any person is without sufficient cause entered in or omitted from the share register of a company; or

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: default is made or unnecessary delay takes place in entering on the register the fact of any person having ceased to be a shareholder,

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the person aggrieved or the company or any shareholder of the company, may make an application to the court for rectification of the register.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where an application is made under this section, the court may order rectification of the register and payment by the company of any damages sustained by any party aggrieved.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: On an application made under this section, the court may decide-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: any question relating to the title of any person who is a party to the application to have his name entered in or omitted from the register, whether the question arises between shareholders or alleged shareholders or between shareholders or alleged shareholders on the one hand and the company on the other hand; and

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: any other question necessary or expedient to be decided for rectification of the register.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: If the court makes an order directing the rectification of the register, the company shall within ten working days of the making of the order, deliver a copy of the order to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (4)-

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Power of court to rectify register.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: In this Act, the term "shareholder" means-

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: a person whose name is entered in the share register as the holder for the time being of one or more shares in the company;

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person named as a shareholder in an application for incorporation of a company at the time of registration of the company;

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person who is entitled to have that person's name entered in the share register under a registered amalgamation proposal as a shareholder in an amalgamated company;

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: until a person's name is entered in the share register, a person to whom a share has been transferred and whose name ought to be but has not been entered in the register.

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: Where a notice of any trust has been entered in the share register in respect of any shares in a company under subsection (2) of section 129, the person for whose benefit those shares are held in trust-

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall be deemed to be a shareholder in the company; and

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall in respect of those shares, enjoy all such rights and privileges and be subject to all such duties and obligations under this Act, as if his name had been entered in the share register as the holder of those shares.

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: Where a company has wrongfully failed to enter in the share register the name of a person to whom shares have been transfered, that person-

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall be deemed to be a shareholder in the company; and

pool.heading: Meaning of "shareholder".
pool.text: shall in respect of those shares, enjoy all such rights and privileges and be subject to all such duties and obligations under this Act, as if his name had been entered in the share register as the holder of those shares.

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: Every private company shall send to the Registrar with its annual return-

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: a declaration signed by the directors of the company to the effect that to the best of their knowledge and belief, they have done all things required to be done by them by or under this Act;

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: a certificate signed by a director and by the secretary of the company-

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: that the company has not since the date of the last return or in the case of a first return, since the date of the incorporation of the company, issued any invitation to the public to subscribe for any shares or debentures of the company;

pool.heading: Declaration and certificate to be sent by private company with annual return.
pool.text: where the annual return discloses the fact that the number of shareholders of the company exceeds fifty, that the excess consists wholly of persons who under section 27, are not to be taken into account in relation to that limit.

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: On the date shown in a certificate of amalgamation-

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamation becomes effective;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: if it has the same name as of one of the amalgamating companies, the amalgamated company shall have the name specified in the amalgamation proposal;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the Registrar shall remove all particulars relating to the amalgamating companies, other than the amalgamated company, from the Register;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamated company succeeds to all the property, rights, powers, and privileges of each of the amalgamating companies;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the amalgamated company succeeds to all the liabilities and obligations of each of the amalgamating companies;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: proceedings pending by or against an amagamating company may be continued by or against the amalgamated company;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: a conviction, ruling, order, or judgment in favour of or against an amalgamating company, may be enforced by or against the amalgamated company;

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: the stated capital of the amalgamated company shall be the sum certified by the auditor of the amalgamated company; and

pool.heading: Effect of certificate of amalgamation.
pool.text: any provisions of the amalgamation proposal that provide for the conversion of shares or rights of shareholders in the amalgamating companies, shall have effect according to their tenor.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Every company which has issued shares shall maintain a share register that records the shares issued by the company, and which includes-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the name and the latest known address of each person who is or has within the last ten years been a shareholder;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the number of shares of each class held by each shareholder within the last ten years; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the date of any-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: issue of shares to;

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: repurchase or redemption of shares from; or

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: transfer of shares by or to,

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: each shareholder within the last ten years, and in relation to the transfer, the name of the person to or from whom the shares were transferred.

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (1)-

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding two hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Company to maintain share register.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: For the purposes of section 200, a director of a company has a relevant interest in a share issued by a company (whether or not the director is registered in the share register as the holder of it) if the director-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: is a beneficial owner of the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: has the power to exercise any right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: has the power to control the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: has the power to acquire or dispose of the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: has the power to control the acquisition or disposition of the share by another person; or

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: under or by virtue of any trust, agreement, arrangement or understanding relating to the share (whether or not that person is a party to it) may at any time have the power to-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: exercise any right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: control the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: acquire or dispose of the share; or

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: control the acquisition or disposition of the share by another person.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: Where a person (whether or not a director of the company) has a relevant interest in a share by virtue of subsection (1), and-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: that person or its directors are accustomed or under an obligation, whether legally enforceable or not, to act in accordance with the directors, instructions, or wishes of a director of the company in relation to-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the exercise of the right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the control of the exercise of any right to vote attached to the share;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the acquisition or disposition of the share; or

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: the exercise of the power to control the acquisition or disposition of the share by another person;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: a director of the company has the power to exercise the right to vote attached to twenty per centum or more of the shares of that person;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: a director of the company has the power to control the exercise of the right to vote attached to twenty per centum or more of the shares of that person;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: a director of the company has the power to acquire or dispose of twenty per centum or more of the shares of that person; or

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: a director of the company has the power to control the acquisition or disposition of twenty per centum or more of the shares of that person,

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: that director has a relevant interest in the share.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: A person who has or may have a power referred to in paragraphs (b) to (f) of subsection (1), has a relevant interest in a share, regardless of whether the power is-

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: expressed or implied;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: direct or indirect;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: legally enforceable or not;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: related to a particular share or not;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: subject to restraint or restriction or is capable of being made subject to restraint or restriction;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: exercisable presently or in the future;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: exercisable only on the fulfillment of a condition;

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: exercisable along or jointly with another person or persons.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: A power referred to in subsection (1) exercisable jointly with another person or persons, is deemed to be exercisable by either or any of those persons.

pool.heading: Meaning of "relevant interest".
pool.text: A reference to a power in this section includes a reference to a power that arises from or is capable of being exercised as the result of a breach of any trust, agreement, arrangement or understanding or any of them, whether or not it is legally enforceable.

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: The certification by a company of any instrument of transfer of shares in or debentures of the company shall be taken as a representation by the company to any person acting on the faith of such certification, that there have been produced to the company such documents as on the face of there show a prima facie title to the shares or debtors in the transferor named in the instrument of transfer, but not as a representation that the transferor has any title to the shares or debentures.

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: Where any person acts on the faith of a false certification made by a company negligently, the company shall be under the same liability to him as if the certification had been made fraudulently.

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section -

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be certified if it bears the words "certificate lodged" or words to the like effect;

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification of an instrument of transfer shall be deemed to be made by a company, where -

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the person issuing the instrument is a person authorised to issue certificated instruments of transfer on the company's behalf; and

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: the certification is signed by a person authorised to certify transfers on the company's behalf or by an officer or servant either of the company or of a body corporate so authorised;

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: a certification shall be deemed to be signed by any person where -

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it purports to be authenticated by his signature or initials, whether handwritten or not; and

pool.heading: Certification of transfers.
pool.text: it is not shown that the signature or initials was or were placed there neither by himself nor by any person authorised to use the signature or initials for the purpose of certifying transfers on the company's behalf.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of subsection (3), every company shall at least once in every year deliver to the Registrar an annual return in the prescribed form, containing the matters specified in the Fifth Schedule hereto.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: The annual return shall be completed within thirty working days from the date of the Annual General Meeting for the year, whether or not that meeting is the first or only meeting of the shareholders in the year. The company shall forthwith forward to the Registrar a copy of the return, signed both by a director and the secretary of the company.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: The provisions of this section shall not apply to a company in the year of its incorporation.

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: Where a company fails to comply with the requirements of subsection (1) or subsection (2)-

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: the company shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one hundred thousand rupees; and

pool.heading: Annual return.
pool.text: every officer of the company who is in default shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: Where a share is redeemable at the option of the holder of the share and the holder gives proper notice to the company requiring the company to redeem the share-

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: the company shall redeem the share on the date specified in the notice or if no date is specified, on the date of receipt of the notice;

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: the share is deemed to be cancelled on the date of redemption; and

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: from the date of redemption, the former shareholder ranks as an unsecured creditor of the company for the sum payable on redemption.

pool.heading: Redemption at the option of the shareholder.
pool.text: A redemption under this section is not a distribution for the purposes of section 56, but is deemed to be a distribution for the purposes of subsection (1) and subsection (3) of section 61.

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: Where a shareholder is entitled to vote on the exercise of the power set out in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) of section 92 and the proposed alteration imposes or removes a restriction on the business or activities in which the company may engage, or set out in paragraph (b) or (c) of subsection (1) of section 92, and the shareholder resolved to exercise those powers, and-

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: the shareholder cast all the votes attached to shares registered in the shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner against the exercise of the power; or

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: where the resolution to exercise the power was passed under section 144, the shareholder did not sign the resolution in respect of the shares registered in the shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner,

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: that shareholder shall be entitled to require the company to purchase those shares in accordance with section 94.

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: Where an interest group has approved the taking of any action that affects the rights attached to shares and the company becomes entitled to take that action, and-

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: a shareholder who was a member of the interest group cast all the votes attached to the shares registered in that shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner against approving the action; or

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: where the resolution approving the taking of the action was passed under section 144, a shareholder who was a member of the interest group did not sign the resolution in respect of the shares registered in that shareholder's name and having the same beneficial owner,

pool.heading: Shareholder may require company to purchase shares.
pool.text: such shareholder shall be entitled to require the company to purchase those shares in accordance with section 94.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: Where the board agree under paragraph (a) of subsection (2) of section 94 to the purchase of the shares by the company, it shall, on giving notice under that subsection or within five working days of doing so-

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: nominate a fair and reasonable price for the shares to be acquired; and

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: give notice of the price nominated to the holder of those shares.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: The shares are deemed to have been purchased by the company upon receipt by the shareholder of a notice under subsection (1).

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: A shareholder who considers that the price nominated by the board is not fair or reasonable, shall forthwith give a notice of objection to the company.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: If within ten working days of giving notice to a shareholder under subsection (1), no objection to the price has been received by the company-

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: the company shall forthwith pay the price nominated to the shareholder; and

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: the shareholder shall forthwith deliver any share certificate in respect of the shares to the company.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: If within ten working days of giving notice to a shareholder under subsection (1), an objection to the price has been received by the company, the company shall within five working days-

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: refer the question as to what amounts to a fair and reasonable price to the auditors of the company; and

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: pay a provisional price in respect of the shares, equal to the price nominated by the board.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: Upon payment of the provisional price by the company, the shareholder shall forthwith deliver any share certificate in respect of the shares to the company.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: Where a reference is made under paragraph (a) of subsection 5, the auditor shall expeditiously determine a fair and reasonable price for the shares to be purchased.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: Where the price determined under subsection (6)-

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: exceeds the provisional price already paid, the company shall forthwith pay the balance owing to the shareholder; or

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: is less than the provisional price already paid, the shareholder shall forthwith repay the excess to the company.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: The auditors may determine the interest on any balance payable or excess to be repaid under subsection (7) at such rate as they think fit, having regard to whether the provisional price paid was reasonable.

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: Where the company fails to refer the question to the auditors under paragraph (a) of subsection (5), a shareholder who has given notice of objection under subsection (3) and a shareholder not satisfied with the price as determined under subsection (6), may apply to court to appoint a fit and proper person for the purposes of determining a fair and reasonable price for the shares and the court may appoint such person as it thinks fit. A person so appointed by court may award interest according to the provisions of subsection (8).

pool.heading: Purchase by company.
pool.text: A purchase of shares by a company under this section is deemed not to be a distribution for the purposes of section 56, but is deemed to be a distribution for the purposes of subsections (1) and (3) of section 61.

label: merged
query_text: A director approves conduct that breaches the company's articles and carries out the decision recklessly without exercising the skill and care reasonably expected from a person with that director's knowledge and experience. Identify the statutory duties breached by the director.

pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: A person exercising powers or performing duties as a director of a company-

pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: shall not act in a manner which is reckless or grossly negligent; and

pool.heading: Directors standard of care.
pool.text: shall exercise the degree of skill and care that may reasonably be expected of a person of his knowledge and experience.

pool.heading: Duty of directors to act in good faith and in the interests of company.
pool.text: A person exercising powers or performing duties as a director of a company shall act in good faith, and subject to subsection (2), in what that person believes to be in the interests of the company.

pool.heading: Duty of directors to act in good faith and in the interests of company.
pool.text: A director of a company which is a wholly owned subsidiary of another company may, if expressly permitted to do so by the company's articles, act in a manner which he believes is in the interest of that other company even though it may not be in the interests of the company of which he is a director.

Any person who is appointed or to his knowledge is proposed to be appointed director of a company at a time when he has attained the age of seventy years or such lower age, if any, as may be specified in the company's articles, shall give notice of his age to the company.

Provisions of subsection (1) shall not apply in relation to a person's reappointment on the termination of a previous appointment as a director of the company, where notice has been given by that person under subsection (1) on any previous occasion.
Any person who-
fails to give notice of his age as required by the provisions of subsection (1); or
acts as director under any appointment which is invalid or which has terminated by reason of his age,
shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.

For the purposes of paragraph (b) of subsection (3), a person who has acted as a director under an appointment which is invalid or has terminated, shall be deemed to have continued so to act throughout the period from the date of the invalid appointment or the date on which the appointment terminated, as the case may be, until the last day on which he acted thereunder.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: Where it appears to the Registrar that there is good reason to investigate the ownership of any shares in or debentures of a company and that it is unnecessary to appoint an inspector for the purpose, the Registrar may require any person whom he has reasonable cause to believe-

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to be or to have been interested in those shares or debentures; or

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to act or to have acted in relation to those shares or debentures as the attorney or agent of any person interested in them,

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: to give the Registrar any information which he has or can reasonably be expected to obtain, as to the present and past interests in those shares or debentures and the names and addresses of the persons interested, and of any person who act or have acted on their behalf in relation to the shares or debentures.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section a person shall be deemed to have an interest in shares or debentures, if he has any right to acquire or dispose of them or of any interest in them or to vote in respect of them, or if his consent is necessary for the exercise of any rights of other persons interested in them, or if other persons interested in them can be required or are accustomed to exercise their rights in accordance with his instructions.

pool.heading: Power to require information as to persons interested in shares or debentures.
pool.text: Any person who fails to give information required of him under subsection (1), or who in giving any such information makes any statement which he knows to be false in a material particular, or recklessly makes any statement which is false in a material particular, shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to an imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Directors to comply with Act and company's articles.
pool.text: A director of a company shall not act or agree to the company acting, in a manner that contravenes any provisions of this Act, or the provisions contained in the articles of the company.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: Where a person-

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: is prohibited from being a director of company under section 213;

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: while a director of a company, has persistently failed to comply with the provisions of this Act;

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: has been convicted of an offence of involving dishonest or fraudulent acts in a country other than Sri Lanka; or

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: was a director of a company which became insolvent and that person's conduct as a director of that company or of any other company makes that person unfit to be a director of a company,

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: the court may make an order that the person shall not, without leave of court, be a director or promoter of or in any way whether directly or indirectly be concerned or take part in the management of a company, for such period not exceeding ten years as may be specified in the order.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: A person intending to apply for an order under this section shall give not less than ten working days' notice of that intention to the person against whom the order is sought. On the hearing of the application the person against whom the order is sought, may appear and give evidence or call witnesses.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: An application for an order under this section may be made by the Registrar or by a liquidator or an administrator of a company of which the person against whom the order is sought was a director, or by a person who is or has been a shareholder or creditor of any such company.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: An order may be made under this section even though the person concerned may be criminally liable in respect of the matters on the ground of which the order is to be made.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: The Registrar of the court shall as soon as practicable after the making of an order under this section, give notice to the Registrar that the order has been made and the Registrar-

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: shall cause to be published in the Gazette the name of the person against whom the order is made; and

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: may give such further notice of the making of the order as he thinks fit.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: Every person who acts in contravention of an order made under this section shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Court may disqualify directors.
pool.text: In this section "company" includes an overseas company which carries on business in Sri Lanka.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where all the shareholders of a private company agree in writing to any action which has been taken, or is to be taken by the company-

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the taking of that action is deemed to be validly authorised by the company, notwithstanding any provision in the articles of the company to the contrary; and

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the provisions contained in the list of sections of this Act specified in the Second Schedule hereto, shall not apply to and in relation to that action.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Without limiting the matters which may be agreed to under subsection (1), the provisions of that subsection shall apply where all the shareholders of a private company agree to or concur in -

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the issue of shares by the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the making of a distribution by the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the repurchase or redemption of shares in the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the giving of financial assistance by a company for the purpose of or in connection with the purchase of shares in the company;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the payment of remuneration to a director, or the making of a loan to a director, or the conferment of any other benefit on a director; or

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the entering into a contract between an interested director and the company.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where a distribution is made by a company under subsection (2) and as a consequence of making that distribution the company fails to satisfy the solvency test, such distribution shall be deemed not to have been made validly.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: A distribution to a shareholder which is deemed not to have been validly made under subsection (3) may be recovered by the company from such shareholder, unless -

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the shareholder received the distribution in good faith and without knowledge of the company's failure to satisfy the solvency test;

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: the shareholder has altered his position relying on the validity of such distribution; and

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: it would be unreasonable in view of the circumstances, to require repayment in full or at all.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where reasonable grounds did not exist for believing that the company would be able to satisfy the solvency test after the making of a distribution which is deemed not to have been validly made, each shareholder who agreed to the making of such distribution will be personally liable to the company, to repay to the company so much of the distribution which the company is not able to recover from the shareholders to whom the distribution was made.

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: Where an action for recovery is brought against a shareholder under subsection (4) or (5), and the court is satisfied that the company could by making a distribution of a lesser amount have satisfied the solvency test, the court may -

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: permit the shareholder to retain; or

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: relieve the shareholder from liability in respect of,

pool.heading: Unanimous agreement of shareholders.
pool.text: an amount equal to the value of any distribution that the company could properly have made under the circumstances.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: A distribution made to a shareholder at a time when the company did not, immediately after the distribution, satisfy the solvency test, may be recovered by the company from the shareholder, unless-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: the shareholder received the distribution in good faith and without knowledge of the company's failure to satisfy the solvency test;

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: the shareholder has altered his position in relying on the validity of the distribution; and

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: it would be unreasonable in view of the circumstances to require repayment in full at all.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: Where in relation to a distribution to which subsection (1) applies, the procedure set out in section 56 has not been followed or reasonable grounds for believing that the company would satisfy the solvency test did not exist at the time the certificate was signed, every director who-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: failed to take reasonable steps to ensure the procedure was followed; or

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: signed the certificate,

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: as the case may be, shall be personally liable to the company to repay to the company, so much of the distribution as the company is not able to recover from the shareholders.

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: Where in an action brought against a director or a shareholder under this section, the court is satisfied that the company could by making a distribution of a lesser amount have satisfied the solvency test, the court may-

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: permit the shareholder to retain; or

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: relive the director from liability in respect of,

pool.heading: Recovery of distributions.
pool.text: an amount equal to the value of any distribution that could properly have been made.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction entered into by the company in which a director of the company is interested, may be avoided by the company at any time before the expiration of six months after the transaction, and the director's interest in it have been disclosed to all the shareholders (whether by means of the company's annual report or otherwise).

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction shall not be avoided under this section if the company receives fair value under it.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: For the purposes of subsection (2), the question whether a company receives fair value under a transaction shall be determined on the basis of the information known to the company and to the interested director, at the time the transaction is entered into.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: If a transaction is entered into by the company in the ordinary course of its business and on usual terms and conditions, the company shall be presumed to have received fair value under the transaction.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section -

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: a person seeking to uphold a transaction and who knew or ought to have known of the director's interest at the time the transaction was entered into, shall have the burden of establishing fair value; and

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: in any other case, the company shall have the burden of establishing that it did not receive fair value.

pool.heading: Avoidance of transaction.
pool.text: A transaction in which a director is interested shall not be avoided on the ground of the director's interest, other than pursuant to this section or the company's articles.

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: A director of a company who has information in his capacity as a director or employee of the company which would not otherwise be available to him, shall not disclose that information to any person or make use of or act on the information, except-

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: for the purposes of the company;

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: as required by law;

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: in accordance with subsection (2); or

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: in any other circumstances in which the company's articles authorise the director to do so.

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: A director of a company may disclose, make use of or act on information, if-

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: the director is first authorised to do so by the board under subsection (3); and

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: particulars of the authorisation are entered in the interests register.

pool.heading: Use of company information.
pool.text: The board authorise a director to disclose, make use of or act on information, if it is satisfied that to do so will not be likely to prejudice the company.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this section, where a prospectus invites persons to subscribe for shares in or debentures of a company, the following persons shall be liable to pay compensation to all persons who subscribe for any shares or debentures on the faith of the prospectus, for the loss or damage they may have sustained by reason of any untrue statement included in such prospectus, that is to say:-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who is a director of the company, at the time of the issue of the prospectus;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who has authorised himself to be named and is named in the prospectus as a director or as having agreed to become a director, either immediately or after an interval of time;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person being a promoter of the company; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: every person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that, where under the provisions of section 38, the consent of any person is required to the issue of a prospectus and such person has given such consent, such person shall not by reason of his having given such consent, be liable under the provisions of this subsection as a person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus, except in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: No person shall be liable under the provisions of subsection (1), if he proves that-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: having consented to become a director of the company he withdrew his consent before the issue of the prospectus and that it was issued without his authority or consent;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the prospectus was issued without his knowledge or consent and that on becoming aware of its issue, he forthwith gave reasonable public notice that it was issued without his knowledge or consent;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: after the issue of the prospectus and before allotment thereunder, he on becoming aware of any untrue statement in such prospectus, withdrew his consent thereto and gave reasonable public notice of the withdrawal and of the reasons therefor; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: (i) as regards every untrue statement not purporting to be made on the authority of an expert or of a public official document or statement, he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the allotment of the shares or debentures, as the case may be, believed that the statement was true;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: as regards every untrue statement purporting to be a statement by an expert or contained in what purports to be a copy of or extract from a report or valuation of an expert, it fairly represented the statement or was a correct and fair copy of or extract from the report or valuation, as the case may be, and he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the issue of the prospectus believed, that the person making the statement was competent to make it and that person had given the consent required under section 38 to the issue of the prospectus and had not withdrawn that consent before delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration or to his knowledge, before allotment thereunder; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: as regards every untrue statement purporting to be a statement made by a person in his official capacity or contained in what purports to be a copy or extract from a public document issued officially, it was a correct and fair representation of the statement or copy or extract from the document:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that the provisions of this subsection shall not apply in the case of a person liable, by reason of his having given the consent required under section 38, as a person who has authorised the issue of the prospectus in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: A person who apart from the provisions of this subsection, would under the provisions of subsection (1) be liable by reason of his having given the consent required under the provisions of section 38 as a person who has authorised the issue of a prospectus in respect of an untrue statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, shall not be so liable, if he proves that -

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: having given his consent under the provisions of section 38 to the issue of the prospectus, he withdrew it in writing before delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration;

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: after delivery of a copy of the prospectus for registration and before allotment thereunder, he on becoming aware of the untrue statement withdrew his consent in writing and gave reasonable public notice of the withdrawal and of the reason therefor; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: he was competent to make the statement and that he had reasonable ground to believe and did up to the time of the allotment of the shares or debentures, as the case may be, believed that the statement was true.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Where-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the prospectus contains the name of a person as a director of the company or as having agreed to become a director of such company and he has not consented to become a director or has withdrawn his consent before the issue of the prospectus and has not authorised or consented to the issue of such prospectus; or

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the consent of a person is required under section 38 to the issue of the prospectus and he either has not given that consent or has withdrawn it before the issue of the prospectus,

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: the directors of the company, except any director without whose knowledge or consent the prospectus was issued, and any other person who authorised the issue of such prospectus, shall be liable to indemnify the person named under paragraph (a), or whose consent was required under paragraph (b), as the case may be, against all damages, costs and expenses to which he may be made liable by reason of his name having been inserted in the prospectus or of the inclusion therein of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, as the case may be, or in defending himself against any action or legal proceeding brought against him in respect thereof:

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Provided that a person shall not be deemed for the purposes of this subsection to have authorised the issue of a prospectus, by reason only of his having given the consent required under section 38 to the inclusion in such prospectus of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: Every person who, by reason of his being a director or being named as a director or as having agreed to become a director or of his having authorised the issue of the prospectus or of the inclusion in such prospectus of a statement purporting to be made by him as an expert, becomes liable to make any payment under this section, may recover contribution as in cases of contract, from any other person who, if sued separately, would have been liable to make the same payment, unless the person who has become so liable was and that other person was not, guilty of fraudulent misrepresentation.

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: For the purposes of this section-

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: "promoter" means a promoter who was a party to the preparation of the prospectus or of the portion thereof containing the untrue statement, but does not include any person by reason of his acting in a professional capacity for persons engaged in procuring the formation of the company; and

pool.heading: Civil liability for untrue in prospectus.
pool.text: "expert" has the same meaning as in section 38.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor may-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: seize, attach and realise, issue execution against or appoint a receiver in respect of property subject to a charge, if entitled to do so;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: value the property subject to the charge and claim in the liquidation-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: as a secured creditor for the amount of his claim, up to the value of the security; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: as an unsecured creditor for the balance due, if any; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: surrender the charge to the liquidator for the general benefit of creditors, and claim in the liquidation as an unsecured creditor for the whole debt.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor may exercise the power referred to in paragraph (a) of subsection (1) whether or not the secured creditor has exercised the power referred to in paragraph (b) of subsection (1).

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor who realises property subject to a charge-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: may claim as an unsecured creditor for any balance due after deducting the net amount realised;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: shall account to the liquidator for any surplus remaining from the net amount realised after satisfaction of the debt, including interest payable in respect of that debt up to the time of its satisfaction and after making any proper payments to the holder of any other charge over the property subject to the charge.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: If a secured creditor values the security and claims as a secured creditor, the valuation and claim shall be made in the prescribed form and shall-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: contain full particulars of the valuation and claim;

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: contain full particulars of the charge including the date on which it was given; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: identify any documents that substantiate the claim and the charge,

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: and the provisions of sections 359, 360 and 362 shall apply to any claim as a secured creditor.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: The liquidator may-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: require production of any document referred to in paragraph (c) of subsection (4); and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: require a claim under subsection (4) to be verified by affidavit.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Where a claim is made by a secured creditor under subsection (4), the liquidator shall either-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accept the valuation and claim; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: reject the valuation and claim in whole or in part, but-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: where a valuation and claim is rejected in whole or in part, the creditor may make a revised valuation and claim within ten working days of receiving notice of the rejection; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: the liquidator may if he subsequently considers that a valuation and claim was wrongly rejected in whole or in part, revoke or amend that decision.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Where the liquidator-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a valuation and claim under paragraph (a) of subsection (6);

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a revised valuation and claim under subparagraph (i) of paragraph (b) of subsection (6); or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: accepts a valuation and claim on revoking or amending a decision to reject a claim under subparagraph (ii) of paragraph (b) of subsection (6),

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: the liquidator shall unless the secured creditor has realised the property, redeem the security on payment of the amount of the claim or the assessed value, whichever is the less.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: The liquidator may at any time by notice in writing, require a secured creditor within twenty working days after receipt of the notice-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: to elect which of the powers referred to in subsection (1) the creditor whishes to exercise; and

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: if the creditor elects to exercise the power referred to in paragraph (b) or paragraph (c) of that subsection, to exercise the power within that period.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor on whom notice has been served under subsection (8) and who fails to comply with the notice shall be taken to have surrendered the charge to the liquidator under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) for the general benefit of creditors, and may claim in the liquidation as an unsecured creditor for the whole debt.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: A secured creditor who has surrendered a charge under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) or who is deemed to have surrendered a charge under subsection (9) may, with the leave of the court or the liquidator and subject to such terms and conditions as the court or the liquidator thinks fit, at any time before the liquidator has realised the property charged-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: withdraw the surrender and rely on the charge; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: submit a new claim under this section.

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: Every person who-

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: makes or authourises the making of a claim under subsection (4) that is false or misleading in a material particular knowing it to be false or misleading; or

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: omits or authorises the omission from a claim under subsection (4) of any matter knowing that the omission makes the claim false or misleading in a material particular,

pool.heading: Rights and duties of secured creditors.
pool.text: shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding one million rupees or to a term of imprisonment not exceeding five years or to both such fine and imprisonment.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: The court may on an application made under this section, make an order restraining a company that, or a director of a company who, proposes to engage in a conduct that would contravene the articles of the company or any provision of this Act, from engaging in that conduct.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: An application may be made by -

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: the company; or

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: a director or shareholder of the company.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: Where the court makes an order under subsection (1), it may also grant such consequential relief as it thinks fit.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: An order may not be made under this section in relation to a conduct or a course of conduct that has been completed.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: The court may at any time before the final determination of an application under subsection (1), make as an interim order, any order that it is empowered to make under that subsection. Such order may at the discretion of the court, be made ex parte or after notice to the respondent. The respondent may make an application for an order of revocation or variation of the exparte order with notice to the petitioner.

pool.heading: Restraining orders.
pool.text: The provision of section 521 shall not apply to any interim order made under this section.

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: A company or a guarantor of an obligation of the company or any person claiming under the company, may not assert against a person dealing with that company or with any person who has acquired rights from the company, that -

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: the articles of the company have not been complied with; or

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: the persons named in the most recent notice filed under section 223 or the annual return delivered under section 131 of this Act, are not the directors or the secretary of the company, as the case may be; or

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: a person held out by a company as a director, officer or agent of the company-

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: has not been duly appointed; or

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: does not have authority to exercise the powers and perform the duties that are customary in the business of the company or are normal for a director, officer or agent of a company carrying on business of the kind carried on by that company; or

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: a document issued by any director, the secretary of the company or by any officer or agent, with actual or normal authority to issue the document, is not valid or genuine,

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: unless that person has, or by virtue of that person's position with or relationship to the company, ought to have knowledge to the contrary.

pool.heading: Authority of directors, officers and agents.
pool.text: The provisions of subsection (1) shall apply even in a situation where a person referred to in paragraphs (b) to (d) of that subsection acts fraudulently or forges a document that appears to have been signed on behalf of the company, unless the person dealing with the company or who has acquired rights from the company, has actual knowledge of such fraud or forgery.

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of subsection (2), a director of a company may rely on reports, statements, and financial data and other information prepared or supplied, and on professional or expert advice given by any of the following persons:-

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: an employee of the company;

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: a professional adviser or expert in relation to matters which the director believes to be within the person's professional or expert competence;

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: any other director or committee of directors in which the director did not serve, in relation to matters within the directors or committee's designated authority.

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: Provisions of subsection (1) shall apply to a director, if, and only if, the director-

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: acts in good faith;

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: makes proper inquiry where the need for inquiry is indicated by the circumstances; and

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: has no knowledge that such reliance is unwarranted.

pool.heading: Use of information and advice.
pool.text: The provisions contained in this Act are in addition to and not in derogation of any provisions contained in any other law relating to the duty or liability of directors or officers of a company.

pool.heading: Exercise and control of liquidator's powers.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act, the liquidator of a company which is being wound up by the court shall, in the administration of the assets of the company and in the distribution thereof among its creditors, have regard to any directions that may be given by resolution of creditors or contributories at any general meeting or by the committee of inspection, and any directions given by the creditors or contributories at any general meeting shall in case of conflict, be deemed to prevail over any directions given by the committee of inspection.

pool.heading: Exercise and control of liquidator's powers.
pool.text: The liquidator may summon general meetings of the creditors or contributories for the purpose of ascertaining their wishes, and it shall be his duty to summon meetings at such times as the creditors or contributories, by resolution, either at the meeting appointing the liquidator or otherwise may direct, or whenever requested in writing to do so by onetenth of the total number of creditors or contributories, as the case may be.

pool.heading: Exercise and control of liquidator's powers.
pool.text: The liquidator may make an application to court in the prescribed manner for directions in relation to any particular matter arising under the winding up.

pool.heading: Exercise and control of liquidator's powers.
pool.text: Subject to the provisions of this Act, the liquidator shall use his own discretion in the management of the estate and its distribution among the creditors.

pool.heading: Exercise and control of liquidator's powers.
pool.text: Where any person is aggrieved by any act or decision of the liquidator, that person may appeal to the court against such act or decision, and the court may confirm, reverse, or modify the act or decision complained of and make such order as it thinks just.

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: A receiver of a company who considers that the company or any director or officer of the company has committed an offence under this Act or the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987, shall report that fact to the Registrar.

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: Nothing in subsection (1) shall impose any duty on a receiver to investigate whether any offence of the kind referred to in that subsection has been committed.

pool.heading: Duty to notify breaches of any provisions of this Act.
pool.text: A receiver who fails to comply with the provisions of subsection (1) shall be guilty of an offence and be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding fifty thousand rupees.
