query_text: A transfer of land is completed in direct contravention of the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act. What is the legal effect of that alienation?

pool.heading: Alienation of land in contravention of this Act to be void
pool.text: Any alienation of land effected in contravention of the provisions of this Act, shall be void and shall have no effect in law.

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in any other written law, the transfer of title of any land situated in Sri Lanka, shall be prohibited if such transfer is-

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a foreigner; or

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: to a foreign company, unless exempted as provided in section 3.

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: For the purpose of maintaining the legal validity of a transfer of land to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, with less than fifty per cent of foreign shareholding, the foreign shareholding of such company shall remain less than fifty per cent, for a minimum period of consecutive twenty (20) years from the date of such transfer.

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Where the foreign shareholding of a company referred to in paragraph (a) reaches or exceeds fifty per cent, contrary to the provisions of paragraph (a), in consequent to-

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: the change of ownership of shares directly or indirectly; or

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: the death of a shareholder of such company and the shares of the deceased shareholder devolving, in accordance with the applicable laws of succession of Sri Lanka, on his next of kin who is a foreigner, the transfer of land referred to therein shall be void and shall have no effect in law, with effect from the date of increase of the foreign shareholding:

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 2(2)(b)(ii), proviso
pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: Provided however, where a company referred to in paragraph (a),-

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange (with a minimum number of two hundred shareholders in the case of a Diri Savi Board and one thousand shareholders in the case of a Main Board), takes steps to reduce its foreign shareholding to less than fifty per cent, within a period of twelve months from the date of increase of its foreign shareholding; or

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: other than a company referred to in sub-paragraph (i), takes steps to reduce its foreign shareholding to less than fifty per cent, within a period of six months from the date of increase of its foreign shareholding, in compliance with the provisions of that paragraph, the transfer of land referred to in paragraph (a), shall be deemed to be legally valid, with effect from the date of restoring the foreign shareholding of such company to less than fifty per cent.

pool.heading: Restriction on transfer of land
pool.text: For the purposes of this section the expressions 'Diri Savi Board' and 'Main Board' shall be read and construed in accordance with the provisions of the Listing Rules of the Colombo Stock Exchange issued under its listing requirements, in terms of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Rules, 2001, made under section 53 of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987 and published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1215/2 of December 18, 2001.

pool.heading: Land Lease Tax not to be levied with effect from January 1, 2016.
pool.text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any of the provisions of this Act, the provisions relating to the Land Lease Tax shall not apply to a lease of any land-

pool.heading: Land Lease Tax not to be levied with effect from January 1, 2016.
pool.text: to a foreigner; or

pool.heading: Land Lease Tax not to be levied with effect from January 1, 2016.
pool.text: to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or

pool.heading: Land Lease Tax not to be levied with effect from January 1, 2016.
pool.text: to a foreign company, under and indenture of lease executed on or after January 1, 2016, and accordingly the Land Lease Tax shall not be charged, levied or collected from any such person or company on or after such date.

pool.heading: Restrictions on mortgaging lands of which title has passed or has been leased to a foreign national.
pool.text: Any land transferred or leased to a person or a company referred to in section 2(1) or 5(1), after the date on which the certificate of the speaker is endorsed in respect of this Act, shall not for any purpose be been mortgaged or pledged to any bank licensed under the Banking Act, for leased to a foreign a period of five years with effect from the execution of the relevant instrument of transfer or lease.

pool.heading: Restrictions on mortgaging lands of which title has passed or has been leased to a foreign national.
pool.text: Any mortgage or pledge executed in contravention of subsection (1), shall be void.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: The Registrar of Lands shall not register an instrument effecting any transfer of title referred to in section 2, under the provisions of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, unless such registrar of lands is satisfied that such transfer is in compliance with the provisions of this Act.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Notwithstanding the provisions of subsection (1), an instrument effecting, the transfer of title of a land to a next of kin (who is a foreigner) of an owner of such land, shall be registered by the Registrar of Lands, where the notary public attesting such instrument of transfer certifies in his attestation that the transferee is the next of kin of the owner of the land transferred, as recognized by the applicable laws of succession of Sri Lanka.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where any question arises whether a person is the next of kin of the owner of the land or which law is applicable to the succession, the Registrar of Lands shall refer the matter to the District Court having jurisdiction over the area in which the relevant land is situated, for a determination through summary proceeding.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where the title of a land is transferred to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, with less than fifty per cent of foreign shareholding, it shall be the duty of the Registrar of Lands to confirm himself whether the foreign shareholding of such company is less than fifty per cent, by requiring the secretary of such company to submit documentary proof to the effect that the foreign shareholding of such company is less than fifty per cent of the total number of shares issued for the time being.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: The secretary to the relevant company shall inform the Registrar of Lands in writing in every six months period commencing from the date of the registration of the relevant deed of transfer, that the foreign shareholding of such company has not exceeded fifty per cent of the total number of shares issued by such company, during the said period of six months.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: Where the foreign shareholding of a company referred to in paragraph (a) reaches or exceeds fifty per cent the relevant Registrar of Land shall make a note to that effect in the relevant folio.

pool.heading: Conditions for the registration of instruments relating to the transfer of title of lands
pool.text: For the purposes of this section 'Registrar of Lands' means the respective Registrar of Lands of the land registry, to whom the instrument of transfer is presented for registration.

pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: In this Act unless the context otherwise requires-

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "alienation"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means transfer, lease or mortgage of lands situated within Sri Lanka;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Apartment Ownership Law"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Banking Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Citizenship Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means Citizenship Act (Chapter 349);

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "citizen of Sri Lanka"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a citizen of Sri Lanka in terms of Citizenship Act;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Companies Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Commissioner General of Inland Revenue"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue appointed or deemed to be appointed under the Inland Revenue Act;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Diplomatic Privileges Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreigner"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a person who is not a citizen of Sri Lanka;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "foreign company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a company or a body of persons incorporated under the laws of any country other than Sri Lanka;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Finance Leasing Act, No. 56 of 2000;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Finance Leasing Institution"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means a Finance Leasing Establishment registered under the Finance Leasing Act;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "holding company"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Inland Revenue Act"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any State or private land and includes-

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(a)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any interest in the land;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(b)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any land covered with water; and

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "land"(c)
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: any house or building stands on that land;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Minister"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Minister to whom the subject of Finance has been assigned;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "transfer"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means any sale, donation, gift or any conveyance by or under which the title of such land passes to another person;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "person"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: includes a body of persons incorporate or unincorporated;

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "Registration of Documents Ordinance"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: means the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117);

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 25, definition of "subsidiary"
pool.heading: Interpretation
pool.text: has the same meaning assigned to such expression under the Companies Act.

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The provisions of section 2 shall not apply to-

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a Diplomatic Mission of another State within the meaning of the Diplomatic Privileges Act or to an International, Multilateral or Bilateral Organization recognized in terms of that Act;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: a condominium parcel specified under the Apartment Ownership Law:

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 3(1)(b), proviso
pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: Provided that, the entire value shall be paid upfront through an inward foreign remittance prior to the execution of the relevant deed of transfer;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a foreign investor in consequence to a decision of the Cabinet of Ministers taken prior to January 1, 2013, involving direct investment of foreign currency, as per the related agreements on such investment structured on the basis of any written law governing the tax regime prior to January 1, 2013, and has ensured compliance by making inward remittances to Sri Lanka;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred by intestacy, gift or testamentary disposition to a next of kin (who is a foreigner) of the in accordance with the applicable law of succession of Sri Lanka;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to a dual citizen of Sri Lanka within the meaning of the Citizenship Act;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to any bank licensed under the Banking Act, in which any foreign shareholding is fifty per cent or above-

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: at an auction conducted by such Bank in terms of the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1990 or Mortgage Act (Chapter 89), in the discharge of a mortgage of such land to such Bank;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in execution of a decree of court to enforce the recovery of a loan given by such bank;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land the title of which is transferred to any Finance Leasing Institution in which any foreign shareholding is fifty per cent or above-

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: where such land has been mortgaged to such Finance Leasing Institution as a security for a lease;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in order to execute a lease and an agreement to sell or a loan and an agreement to sell;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: in execution of a decree of court to enforce the recovery of a loan given by such Institution;

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land, the title of which was transferred to a company referred to in section 2(1)(b), during the period commencing from January 1, 2013 and ending on the date on which the certificate of the speaker is endorsed in respect of this Act, provided such company has been in active operation in Sri Lanka for a period of not less than ten (10) consecutive years prior to the date of transfer of such land; and

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: any land, the title of which is transferred on or after April 1, 2018, to a company referred to in paragraph (b) of subsection (1) of section 2, listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange.

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The Minister may in consultation with the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned and with the prior written approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, by Order published in the Gazette, exempt any foreign entity engaged in the banking, financial, insurance, maritime, aviation, advanced technology or infrastructure development project identified as a Strategic Development Project, in terms of the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008, from the application of the provisions of section 2.

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: The Minister may in consultation with the Minister to whom the subject of Lands has been assigned and with the prior written approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, by Order published in the Gazette, exempt any foreign company engaged in international commercial operations, from the application of the provisions of section 2, where the land is purchased to locate or relocate its global or regional operations or to set up a branch office.

pool.heading: Exemption from the application of the provisions of section 2.
pool.text: Where the transfer of title of a land is effected in terms of this section, the provisions of this Act shall also apply to every subsequent transfer of title of such land or part thereof.

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary in any other written law, the leasing of a land-

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a foreigner; or

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, where any foreign shareholding in such company, either direct or indirect, is fifty per cent or above; or

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: to a foreign company, shall be effected subject to the payment of the Land Lease Tax imposed under section 6:

pool.citation: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, s 5(1)(c), proviso
pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Provided however, the maximum tenure of any such lease shall not exceed ninety nine years.

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Any State land so leased shall be re-vested on the State free of encumbrances upon the lapse of the period of lease.

pool.heading: Restrictions on the leasing of lands to foreigners
pool.text: Any state land so leased shall not be sub-let or subleased violating the provisions of relevant indenture of lease or without obtaining the prior written approval from the Minister to whom the subject of lands has been assigned.
